title: Control-System Variable Data
description: Control-system variable data observed by a RailDS edge collector. state_scope identifies whether the payload contains a complete current state or only variables reported as changing in one control-system event.

asset_id.description: Optional configured identifier for the monitored asset, site, or collection context associated with this control-system source.

state_scope.description: Scope of the variable data in this payload. full contains the complete current variable state available from the source. partial contains only variables reported as changing in the control-system event.

control_system.description: Identity, collector connection, and operating context of the source.

name.description: Configured human-readable name of the control-system source.

connection.description: Collector-local connection through which this data was received. The connection may be serial, socket, or another supported transport.

type.description: Transport used by the collector connection.

id.description: Collector-local identifier for the configured connection.

mode.description: Observed or derived operating mode when known.

control_system_event_time.description: Timestamp associated with a state_scope=partial event by the control system. When no UTC offset is present, it is controller-local time and must not be interpreted as UTC.

variable_states.description: Complete current variable state available from the control-system source when state_scope is full.

variable_change.description: One variable transition. If state_scope is full, this represents the current state of the variable and old_value is null. If state_scope is partial, these changes must be interpreted in order and the same variable may show up more than once.

index.description: Numeric variable index or address assigned by the control system.

name.description: Variable name reported or resolved by the collector.

old_value.description: Value immediately before this transition, or null when the previous value is unavailable.

data_type.description: Collector classification of the variable value type.
